page.content:
Creator whose audience and income live primarily on the platform.

How YouTuber connects

  • Topic: YouTube — YouTubers are the creators whose channels live on the platform.
  • Faction: YouTube Partner Program — The Partner Program turned 'YouTuber' into a paying occupation.
  • Creator: PewDiePie — PewDiePie is the platform-lore example of an independent YouTuber at global scale.
  • Item: YouTube Studio — Creators run analytics and claims from YouTube Studio.
  • Work: Let's Play — Let's Plays minted a generation of Partner-program YouTubers.
  • Work: Vlog — The vlog is a home genre for talking-head YouTubers.
  • Faction: Smosh — Smosh was among the first sketch channels to become a YouTuber brand.

What is YouTuber?

YouTuber became the job title for people who post on a channel, talk to a camera, and treat analytics as craft. The Partner Program made the word a career, not a hobby.

Key threads lead to YouTube, YouTube Partner Program, PewDiePie, YouTube Studio, Let's Play and Vlog.
